findings.description: Net I2C_SDA has 60% reference plane coverage over 8.3mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.title: Decoupling cap too far from U1
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U1 (ESP32-DevKitC 38-pin) is 9.6mm away. Each mm of trace adds 0.3-0.8 nH of loop inductance, reducing decoupling effectiveness at high frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap within 2-3mm of U1 power pins.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap too far from U1

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U4
findings.description: U4 (A7680C TDM2309 4G) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U4 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U4 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U4

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U2
findings.description: U2 (MPU6050 GY-521 MODULE) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U2 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U2 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U2

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U3
findings.description: U3 (GPS NEO-7M GY-GPSU3) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U3 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U3 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U3

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (EXTERNAL 5V 2A SIM INPUT) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: J2 appears to be a power-only connector (all pins are power/ground rails). A board-level ferrite bead would saturate at typical power-supply currents. If radiated EMI is a concern on the cable, add a system-level common-mode choke or use shielded cable with chassis termination.

findings.recommendation: J1 appears to be a power-only connector (all pins are power/ground rails). A board-level ferrite bead would saturate at typical power-supply currents. If radiated EMI is a concern on the cable, add a system-level common-mode choke or use shielded cable with chassis termination.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (95×70mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 752 MHz; (0,1) at 1021 MHz; (1,1) at 1268 MHz; (2,0) at 1504 MHz; (2,1) at 1818 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

coverage_matrix.note: Design rule checks identify common radiation sources. Cannot predict absolute emission levels.
Switching harmonic analysis and decoupling checks. EMI filter verification not yet implemented.
